name: Liescha
source:
Second year student, Linear rifle department official
Psychokinetits: Eagle Eye Lv5
Side effects: Her bust size goes from a U Cup to a Z Cup

[u]~Masturbation Data~[/u]
•Average Weekly Masturbation Amount: 6 times
•First Masturbation Experience: She used the stock of her rifle to rub her crotch in the 1st year of middle school as her first time.
•Masturbation Comment: She started masturbating because of the sensations she felt from her breast milk aspirator, which sucked out the excess milk from her Z Cup breasts from overuse of her ability.

A princess studying abroad from the Neuegerman Principality in Europe. She is passionate, intelligent, and dislikes losing. She has a heroic spirit and will defend the weak. She does not have many female friends at Toaru Academy, most likely due to her radiant and intimidating aura or so the [url=/c83707]protagonist[/url] has heard. In addition, because she has been sheltered her entire life as a princess, she is naïve about the world and there are many things she does not understand. She has no experience with love or the opposite sex, so she is very interested in the protagonist (After meeting him, she has learned a lot about erotic manga and anime. Though shy about it at first, she has gotten a bit interested in them).

Her Psychokinetits abilities are [Linear Control (Magnetic Force Control)] and [Eagle Eye (Distant Control Ability)]. She has established and operates a linear rifle department with special facilities in which she can use her skills. Her linear rifle is customized for competition; it is a 20 mm super-range anti material rifle known as the [Gepart M5] manufactured by Kenih Wegman (The recoil force of the gun can be handled by Lecia's abilities. She can also use her powers to create a magnetic lens in which to guide pellet bullets).
*Linear rifle shooting competitions typically compete in a range of 1-2 kilometers.

The side effects of her powers cause her U cup breasts to grow into Z cup breasts. She has a limit of 10 shots from her linear rifle until the effects form.

She encountered the protagonist when she got lost in the school (she has terrible directional awareness as well). Her favorite things involve vehicles, guns, anime, and comics. She seems like a complete female otaku.

The [Neuegerman Principality] is a neutral country surrounded by beautiful mountains and lakes in Western Europe. It boasts a population size to that of Shikoku in Japan, with around 5 million citizens. Its main industries are tourism and precision machinery. Specifically, its precision machinery industry (which makes things such as medical devices, optical equipment, and military gadgets) is valued highly around the world.
